orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
WPSS No. 1689 of 2020 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. P.S. Bisht, Addl. C.S.C. with Mr. 
Virendra Singh Rawat, Brief Holder for the 
State/respondent nos. 1 to 5. 
Heard. 
Issue notice to respondent nos. 6 & 7 
fixing 23.02.2021. 
Steps be taken within a weeks. 
Respondents may file counter affidavit in 
the meantime. 
Having heard learned counsel for the 
parties, as an interim measure, it is directed 
that the effect and operation of the impugned 
order dated 25.11.2020 shall remain stayed 
till the next date of listing. 
Stay application (CLMA 10894 of 2020) 
stands disposed of accordingly. 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
mamta 15.12.2020

WPSS No.1689 of 2020
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate, for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Narain Dutt, Brief Holder, for the 
State/respondent nos.1 to 5.
Counter affidavit filed on behalf of 
respondent no.6 is taken on record. Miscellaneous 
application (IA No.10850 of 2021) stands disposed 
of accordingly. 
Let fresh notice be issued to respondent no.7. 
Steps to be taken within a week.
Counter affidavit may be filed by the other 
respondents within four weeks.
List this matter after four weeks showing the 
name of Mr. Birendra Singh Adhikari, as counsel for 
respondent no.6.
Interim order, if any, is continued till the next 
date of listing.
 
 (Ravindra Maithani,J.) 23.02.2021
Nitesh
